message.reasoning: The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or use `docker-machine start default`. But the user likely wants to start Docker Desktop. We can give instructions: open Docker Desktop app, or use command line: `& 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'` or `Start-Service com.docker.service`. But we have a tool to execute commands. We can call the function to run a command. The user wants to start Docker on Windows. So we can provide a command: `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` or `net start com.docker.service`. Let's use PowerShell: `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service`. We'll call the function.
